title: DataPrepX Job
description: Canonical job/run contract shared by gateway-go, ml-engine-py, and agent-orchestrator. This file is the single source of truth for the job wire format (planner Phase 1) -- do not fork or duplicate this shape per service.

jobStatus.description: Mirrors the Celery task-graph states described in CLAUDE.md §5.7. Phase 1's stub worker only ever produces queued -> running -> done|failed; gate-check and optimizing are reserved for Phase 2+ once real pipeline stages exist.

jobSubmitRequest.description: Body of POST /v1/jobs. Phase 1 only supports a synthetic no-op job (dataset_id is optional/null), so the RL/MAML/Optuna config fields are not yet part of this contract -- they land with their respective phases.

dataset_id.description: References datasets.id. Null for a Phase 1 synthetic no-op job.

config.description: Opaque job configuration, hashed into runs.config_hash. Left schema-free at Phase 1; will gain a proper sub-schema as pipeline config surfaces are defined in later phases.

job.description: Representation returned by POST /v1/jobs and GET /v1/jobs/{id}, and the payload streamed over the /v1/jobs/{id}/ws WebSocket on every status transition.

config_hash.description: sha256 of the submitted config, per lineage.py's content-addressing scheme (CLAUDE.md §5.3).
